name: Retrieve information on crimes and legal cases
description: Users asked for detailed factual information regarding specific criminal cases, legal proceedings, incidents involving high-profile individuals, organized crime groups, and policing practices. While some requests focused on retrieving historical or news-based accounts of murders, scandals, and convictions, others sought explanations of investigative tactics, surveillance registration protocols, or statistical data related to the criminal justice system.
